nodes.title: PARTS - only for a long video made part by part
READ ME 1: how to use
widgets_values:
HOW TO USE THIS WORKFLOW

Most of the time you look at three places, top left:
  MODE: what kind of video (T2V, I2V, L2V, FL2V, REF2V), one clip or parts, extend a video, second pass on/off. It also lists the files you chose and ticks them on or off.
  IDEA: your own text. Save ideas you like and flip through them with the arrows. Pick the prompt template, or switch the prompt writer off to use your text as it is.
  PARTS: only for a long video made part by part.
Everything else is set once: models, the Load nodes (files), and the settings.

1. Once: pick your models in 'Loader' and a language model in 'Prompt writer'.
2. Choose the MODE. The mode decides how the video is built, see the next note.
3. Choose the files for that mode in the Load nodes (first / last frame, pictures, videos, sounds) and tick them on. Upload adds new files.
4. Write the IDEA. Press Run. The written prompts and a timing report appear at the end; SAVE VIDEO saves the video.

Another scene: only change the idea (or pick a saved idea). The files and settings stay.
Length: 'seconds' in Video format (any length). For a long video choose 'several parts' in MODE and write the parts in PARTS.

nodes.title: READ ME 2: modes
widgets_values:
THE MODES - each one encodes the video differently (not only a different prompt)

T2V  text to video: no pictures. The video starts from an empty latent; only your text steers it.
I2V  first frame to video: needs FIRST FRAME. The picture is encoded and anchored at frame 0 (and the text encoder sees it), the rest is generated. Prompt template I2VA.
L2V  last frame to video: needs LAST FRAME. The picture is anchored at the final frame; the video moves towards it. Template L2VA.
FL2V first and last frame: needs both. Anchored at frame 0 and at the end. Template FL2VA.
REF2V references: pictures (up to 9), videos (up to 3, with sound) and sounds (up to 3) are encoded as references that stay the same all through the video; you can also anchor a first frame. Name them in the idea: <Picture 1>, <Video 1>, <Audio 1>. Best with a ref2va checkpoint. Template Ref2VA.

The first / last frame are cropped to the video's shape (never stretched): use pictures of the same shape.
Extend a video (a switch in MODE): works with any mode; the ending of your video (frames and sound) is anchored at the start, and the result contains both.
Several parts (in MODE + PARTS): each part continues the previous one (Continuity); in I2V the first frame is for the first part, in L2V / FL2V the last frame is for the last part.
Quick preview: switch two_stage_upscale off in MODE: first pass only, much faster. On = full quality.
Smoother motion: un-bypass the interpolation node (Ctrl+B) and set Save Video frame_rate to 48.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: Write what happens, who is in it, the look and the sound. Name references like <Picture 1> or <Audio 1> (REF2V). Prompt writer off = your text is the finished prompt.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: Only used when MODE is 'several parts'. One box per part, + / - for the number. A box can start with (10s) for its own length, or raw: for a finished prompt.

widgets_values_named.text: Only used when MODE is 'several parts'. One box per part, + / - for the number. A box can start with (10s) for its own length, or raw: for a finished prompt.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: Pick the diffusion model, the text encoder and the VAEs once. The extra VAE (2x detail) decodes every video at twice the size. LoRAs apply to the model. The prompt writer is a separate small language model that turns your idea into H3 prompts.

widgets_values: I2V needs the first frame, L2V the last frame, FL2V both. Choose the file, tick it on (here or in MODE). The picture is cropped to the video's shape, so use the same shape.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: REF2V: up to 9 reference pictures. Choose the file, describe what it is (or keep the stored description), tick it on. Use them for characters, places, objects, styles.

widgets_values_named.text: REF2V: up to 9 reference pictures. Choose the file, describe what it is (or keep the stored description), tick it on. Use them for characters, places, objects, styles.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: REF2V: up to 3 reference videos with their sound (2-15 seconds is best): motion, a person's look and voice, a camera move. Upload adds a file.

widgets_values_named.text: REF2V: up to 3 reference videos with their sound (2-15 seconds is best): motion, a person's look and voice, a camera move. Upload adds a file.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values: REF2V: up to 3 sounds: a voice, music, an effect. They are given to the model as they are; the description tells the prompt writer what each one is. Upload adds a file.

widgets_values_named.text: REF2V: up to 3 sounds: a voice, music, an effect. They are given to the model as they are; the description tells the prompt writer what each one is. Upload adds a file.

widgets_values: To extend a video you already have: upload / choose it here (max_seconds 0 = all of it), enable it, and switch 'extend_existing_video' on in MODE. The result starts with your video and continues it.

nodes.title: How
widgets_values:
Video format: size and length in seconds.
Continuity: how parts join (parts only).
Sampling: first pass (defaults follow 10Eros Max: er_sde, sgm_uniform, 8 steps, shift 12/3).
Second pass: upscales and refines with 3 steps; switched off by MODE.
Live preview: what you watch while it samples.
Speed and memory: sparse attention (turn off for models that are not FastH3-based).
